rationale: Retain a runnable real-writer/SQLite lifetime regression; internal Map size measures retained path metadata, not bytes or RSS. Before/current source hashes constrain the comparison.

cases.title: before: 1,000 retirements and never-indexed stale commit fence
cases.reason: Actual archived writer with current production SQLite schema retires 1,000 indexed file rows; original removals Map retains all 1,000 paths while a removed in-flight first write still cannot commit.

cases.title: after: 1,000 retirements and never-indexed stale commit fence
cases.reason: Actual current writer releases all path lifetimes and file rows after 1,000 cycles; a never-indexed source removed after beginWrite cannot resurrect a file row.

cases.title: named baseline/current bundle and real SQLite driver
cases.reason: Only the writer version is substituted; real schema/adapter stay bundled, SQL counts and retained-map size are independently asserted, writer/database close in finally, both source hashes and runtime are printed.
